english:
Applying a Darkness debuff to a non-Boss Combatant makes it take 75% increased <solar Solar /> damage for 20 seconds, shown by yellow numbers.

Stacks with other Weaken sources.

Has a 2 second cooldown before another Combatant can be affected.

source.text:
Upon inflicting a Darkness Debuff on a Non-Boss Combatants:

Combatant takes 75% Increased Solar Damage for 20 seconds.
Indicated by getting Yellow Numbers on Solar Damage.

Stacks with other Weaken sources.

Incurs a 2 second cooldown before another combatant can be inflicted by Cauterized Darkness.
